method: Follow-up port check (24 Oct 2026): every unresolved source object compared by nearest-surface coverage against all nine decoded 0.1.8 GLBs, calibrated on 320 exact-named controls (312 same-structure). Each row below was then reviewed individually by name, collection, side and position.

additions.current_id: Abductor digiti minimi on base of prox. phal. of 5th finger.l
additions.rationale: Left twin of the right-side patch already shipped as 'Abductor digiti minimi on base of prox. phal. of 5th finger.r' (same source shape mirrored). Left patch absent: best own-system coverage 13% within 1 mm, nearest is a different muscle's attachment.

additions.current_id: Abductor hallucis on medial process of calcaneal tuberosity.l
additions.rationale: Left twin of shipped '...calcaneal tuberosity.r'. Left patch absent: 21% within 1 mm, nearest is flexor digitorum brevis attachment.

additions.source_id: Deep head of flexor pollicis brevis.o1l
additions.current_id: Deep head of flexor pollicis brevis on 1st metacarpal bone.l
additions.rationale: Left twin of shipped '...on 1st metacarpal bone..r' (source double period not carried over). Left patch absent: 3% within 1 mm.

additions.current_id: Extensor hallucis longus on fibula and interosseus membrane.l
additions.rationale: Shipped '.l' node is a copy of the right-side patch (centre x -101 mm, same 1408 triangles as '.r'), so the left leg had no patch. Replace it with the real left source surface (centre x +100 mm).

additions.current_id: Tibialis posterior on post. surface of interosseus membrane.l
additions.rationale: Shipped '.l' node is a copy of the right-side patch (centre x -105 mm, same 2542 triangles as '.r'). Replace with the real left source surface (centre x +94 mm).

additions.rationale: Left twin of shipped '...5th metatarsal head.r'. No left patch in insertions (0% within 1 mm).

Right side of the same absent insertion patch.
Ethmoid air cells are distinct named sinus cavities. Only 19% of the surface lies within 1 mm of the whole Ethmoid bone mesh (4x larger).
15% within 1 mm of Ethmoid bone; distinct named cavity.
34% within 1 mm of Ethmoid bone; distinct named cavity.
Scalp hair surface. Only 42% within 1 mm of the shipped 'Hair' region; added as its own object, 'Hair' unchanged.
Inner gastric lining, distinct from the Stomach wall surface (60% within 1 mm, size ratio 1.2, would be hidden inside Stomach). Added as its own selectable object.

Reverses the 0.1.8 'unresolved' decision. Pleura is a separate membrane wrapping the lungs, not a lung lobe; 98.7% within 2 mm is expected for a membrane on the lung surface. Added as its own object; lung lobes unchanged.

renames.rationale: Source labels are inverted: '.l' sits at x -53.8 mm (body right). Glb node names swapped so '.l' is the body-left ligament. Geometry and transforms untouched.
